aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab was founded by Dominic Bonini, who built Village Foodie to find out which food trucks are coming to his village. It is a small company and he runs it himself.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.hatchgrab: The more food trucks I got to know, the more I thought they deserved better tools: something made for a business that is somewhere else every day, not for a restaurant with a fixed address. That is why I founded HatchGrab.
aboutPage.story.small: It is a small company and I run it myself. If you get in touch, I will answer you, not a support queue.
aboutPage.story.village: I live in a village. Food trucks come to us, but I never knew which one was coming and when without having to dig through Facebook.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: So I built Village Foodie — a simple way to find out which food trucks are coming to villages near you.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order ahead for a specific day or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Break down sales by period, item and event and see what really sells.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — you do not have to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Assign a pager buzzer number to an order when you hand it to the customer, so you know which pager belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen visible to customers that shows order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so customers nearby find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one leads straight to its order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen and the only way to take orders even when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. Once a time slot is full, customers cannot choose it.

featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into meal deals and offer add-ons when ordering to raise the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as WhatsApp auto-replies, for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the counter and in the kitchen — all with the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own logins with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: When you lose signal, online orders pause so customers cannot place orders you will not see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you take orders offline too; the web dashboard needs a connection.

featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a cut-off for items that need preparation time.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that do not show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from a picture you already publish on Facebook. You just check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically send customers an SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your artwork — we add your dates, places and times for each week and event automatically.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out with one tap — it greys out for customers immediately.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock count and it counts down as orders come in, until the item sells out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, without a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print kitchen tickets for orders on a printer with Bluetooth or a cable connection in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a time slot as their collection time, so demand spreads over the whole service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders right at the food truck, paid on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your sales from the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatic replies to WhatsApp enquiries about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once and how long it takes. Once a collection time is full, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron pocket, on the tablet on the counter, on the laptop in the food truck — and on the card terminal you already take payments on.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable wi-fi and the same opening hours every week. You are somewhere else every week, at a different time, with weak or no mobile signal. HatchGrab was made exactly for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: When you lose signal, online orders pause automatically so customers cannot place orders you will not see. You keep taking orders in the app for iPhone, iPad and Android.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the artwork you already publish on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in your dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automatic posts for Facebook and Instagram
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Shorter queues, and food ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Created for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp messages get answered while you drive to the pitch or stand at the grill — based on your menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
